images.title: 9 kg 600 g shared into 3 equal boxes
images.purpose: Show that sharing a weight equally divides both parts: 9 kg 600 g shared by 3 gives 3 kg 200 g in each box.
images.composition: One long load at the top with three arrows down to three equal boxes, and the working below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. WHOLE LOAD: one long rounded rectangle 1000 by 110 px at x 228 to 1228, y 130 to 240, filled pale teal #CCE5F2 with a 4 px outline #0072B2, holding the text 9 kg 600 g (56 px, bold, dark #1F2937). THREE ARROWS: three thick grey #6B7280 arrows 70 px long pointing down from the load at x 478, 728 and 978, from y 260 to y 330. THREE BOXES in a row at y 350 to 480, each a rounded rectangle 280 by 130 px filled amber #E69F00 with a 3 px dark outline, left edges at x 338, 588 and 838, each holding the text 3 kg 200 g (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937). WORKING LINES centred at x 728 (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937): at y 580 the text 9 ÷ 3 = 3 kg; at y 650 the text 600 ÷ 3 = 200 g; at y 730 the text 3,200 × 3 = 9,600 g (a check, 36 px, grey #6B7280). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of boxes that differs from 3 or arrows from 3
a box with a weight other than 3 kg 200 g
images.takeaway: Sharing equally means dividing both parts, and multiplying back checks it.
images.description: A load of 9 kg 600 g with three arrows to three boxes of 3 kg 200 g, and the working below.
images.context: Concept image for Sharing a Weight Equally. It follows the idea of dividing a weight in kg and g in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Divide the kg, then the g, then multiply back. The slip to watch: dividing only the kg part.

image_decisions.why: The three equal boxes make the sharing visible.
